Generic Python Git/restoration verifiers remain separate local components. This campaign binds host stop observations, fixture output artifacts and durable receiver seals, not arbitrary imported Git objects or generic artifact PASS ingestion.

The HTTP replay tests intentionally replace the available observation after proof ingestion, then replay the same command and restore the original observation. This demonstrates reuse of persisted verified proof, not admission of a new invalid observation.
